biotools.summary: TIPC is a computational algorithm that measures immune cell partitioning and clustering within the tumor microenvironment to identify tumor subtypes with distinct spatial patterns. It has been applied to colorectal and hepatocellular carcinoma datasets to reveal prognostic associations and critical cell interactions.
